Recorded responses reconstructed from Vercel's public OpenAPI spec
(openapi.vercel.sh, servers api.vercel.com) and the REST reference pages
under vercel.com/docs/rest-api/sandboxes, read 2026-10-22, with the NDJSON
log line shape and the 504 bytesWritten field as the REST pages describe
them. No live call was made and no token was used; field names and shapes
are the spec's, values are illustrative. The stdin 504 error code string is
not named by the spec (only the status and bytesWritten are) and is
illustrative.
